name: Love is a Monster
source:
Use your elemental touch to reveal the monster who cursed your town. Will they ruin you before you seduce them?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
使用你的元素之触来揭露诅咒你的城镇的怪物。在你引诱他们之前，他们会毁掉你吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
